applicabilityBasis.summary: HKDAP is a HKD fiat-referenced payment and settlement stablecoin issued by Anchorpoint Financial Limited under HKMA licence FRS01. Its August 12, 2026 whitepaper documents institutional beta issuance and 1:1 HKD redemption via authorised distributors; it is not a bank deposit.

genius.notes: Anchorpoint holds an HKMA stablecoin issuer licence for HKDAP, but no U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, OCC foreign-issuer registration, or Treasury comparability determination was found. The current issuer whitepaper and transparency hub document an institutional beta from August 12, 2026, rather than only a planned product: September 30 weekly unaudited reserves and circulation are public, and the whitepaper contains a 1:1 HKD redemption policy with eligibility, distributor access, fees and procedures. Independent periodic attestation is promised only after full launch, so monthlyAttestationPresent remains false; weekly unaudited figures are not monthly attestation. The catalog remains pre-launch and this review does not change lifecycle metadata. The Standard Chartered parent and HKMA licence FRS01 do not establish a U.S. GENIUS route. DASP not-yet-restricted reflects GENIUS timing rather than permission under other U.S. laws.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official GENIUS application, OCC foreign-issuer registration or Treasury comparability determination was located for Anchorpoint Financial Limited or HKDAP. The finding is limited to the opened public materials and exact-name searches; it does not establish that the issuer is ineligible or has no nonpublic application.
